analyses.reason: Definition external IFRS revenue, but segment input identities upstream_revenue/downstream_revenue refer to sales-related income including intersegment. Original annual PDF52/58 and note4PDF196 distinguish external, other sales-related income and internal revenue. Require reconciliation to group revenue and eliminations, not sum headline segment rows; production is not sales volume.

Explicitly distinguish operating income, issuer EBIT, adjusted EBIT and net income. Annual PDF47 defines EBIT including finance-income treatment; note4 has JV results and eliminations. Sector EBIT cannot be called a share of group operating income without bridge. EPS if later added uses attributable ordinary earnings and weighted shares, not total net income/end shares; EBITDA not automatically operating income+D&A across mixed scopes.

Issuer FCF=OCF minus positive cash-capex outflow (annual PDF46); if source capex signed negative use addition, avoid subtracting negative. Not investment cash flow or investment guidance. Coverage not financing provenance. cash_flow_end requires reconciliation to balance cash, held-for-sale, overdrafts and scope.

Positive separation from capital-investment guidance. Bind cash PP&E/capex/additions/intangibles/acquisitions and external investment definitions before comparisons. Segment cash capex, group cash capex and guaranteed commitments are not interchangeable or additive without reconciliation.

Debt-issued/repaid are flows, borrowings/leases balances; total liabilities is not debt. Require opening/closing debt, leases, cash/restricted cash and issuer net-debt definition; working-capital signed changes not level differences without reconciliation. EBITDA/net debt scope must match; current list insufficient for approved leverage output.

Declared vs paid vs payout policy separate, base policy not automatically liability. Dividend coverage is a non-IFRS ratio nested under ifrs_line_item; add definition gate per output, match period/signs and parent vs NCI. basic_eps/weighted shares listed but no approved EPS output; hold.

ROACE changed definition (annual PDF45-46 new/old bridge); no implicit comparable time series. ROE numerator attributable earnings vs parent equity, ROA numerator/group assets and opening/closing average bases must be explicit. FY/quarter/YTD and annualization are not interchangeable.
